title: Le Ruban Bleu, Herman Chittison and unrecorded club work
summary: She stayed six years at Le Ruban Bleu working with great musicians; much of her best work there was never taped.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: You know, when I went into Le Ruban Bleu to work with Herman Chittison, one of the reasons why I stayed there so long was because I thought I might be able to get Herman Chittison, you know, to record with me, and also go on the road, because I could've done a lot of --
He wouldn't budge! He didn't want to get up off the stool. And then, he was soloist -- a soloist himself.
But I stayed at Le Ruban Bleu for six years because I wanted someone like Chittison on the road with me.
But I couldn't budge him and --
Nobody took a portable tape recorder into --
Oh! Boy, some of the best things that I have done were done there over a period of six years.
And I did a lot of things that were currently popular and all that. But it never happened.
